Show name : Proyecto  Final (Final Project)
total episodes: 20 short episodes (~10 min each
perfect binge)
genre: teen thriller, drama, mystery, dark romance
aired: july 2026 
setting: Mexico El - new school, old secrets
: Netflix (rated TV-MA)
“Nueva escuela. Viejos secretos. Un amor inesperado. Una cuenta anónima que no la deja olvidar.”
The dark Mexican teen thriller everyone is talking about
Tamara transferred to a new school hoping for a fresh start. Instead she got labeled: loca, rarita, vampira. Cyberbullied. Humiliated. Turned into the school’s biggest joke by Xavi and his group
So she reinvents herself. She transforms. And now she wants REVENGE
But then Xavi - the boy who broke her - starts looking at her differently. And an anonymous account starts messaging her, knowing things nobody should know
How far will Tamara go to stop being the victim?
Daniela Martínez Caballero delivers a haunting performance as Tamara. Tristán Maze as Xavi has that dangerous “look at me differently” energy that BookTok is going to lose it over .

A sharp critique of digital cruelty, toxic beauty standards, and the dark side of teen social media culture
Comparisons are already flying to Élite and 13
Reasons Why - but Proyecto Final hits harder because it’s SHORT, SHARP, and doesn’t waste a single minute
If you loved Elite, Rebelde, Wednesday, or Culpa Mía — this is your next weekend binge
